hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: the 21 domains sharing zone-edit date 2026-08-20 were registered or configured as one batch
hypothesis_tests.test: sampled 12 Hostinger-nameserver domains discovered by the expansion sweep that are unrelated to any cluster, and read their SOA serials
hypothesis_tests.result: 12 of 12 controls carry the same 2026-08-20 serial
hypothesis_tests.verdict: FALSIFIED - provider-wide serial bump, not operator activity

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: the 8 GoDaddy domains sharing zone-edit date 2026-02-05 were configured as one batch
hypothesis_tests.test: sampled 79 GoDaddy-nameserver domains discovered by the expansion sweep that belong to no cluster, and read their SOA serials
hypothesis_tests.result: 0 of 79 controls carry the 2026-02-05 serial; control dates are widely dispersed (most common is 2023-09-19 at 8 of 79)
hypothesis_tests.verdict: SURVIVES - 2026-02-05 is not a GoDaddy-wide event, so the 8 domains share a genuine same-day configuration event

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: the 8 GoDaddy domains that share zone-edit date 2026-02-05 were registered together
hypothesis_tests.test: read the RDAP registration date of each member
hypothesis_tests.verdict: PARTIAL - 2 of 8 registered on 2024-05-15; the rest were registered on other days and only reconfigured together on 2026-02-05

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: Group 1 members were registered in bursts (same registrar, <= 10 min apart)
hypothesis_tests.test: chain each member's registry registration timestamp with the group's other members at the same registrar; compare with the control-population burst share
hypothesis_tests.result: 14 of 31 members sit in 5 intra-group burst(s); control-population burst share is 6.1%
hypothesis_tests.verdict: SUPPORTED - 45% of the group vs 6.1% baseline

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: Group 2 members were registered in bursts (same registrar, <= 10 min apart)
hypothesis_tests.test: chain each member's registry registration timestamp with the group's other members at the same registrar; compare with the control-population burst share
hypothesis_tests.result: 9 of 16 members sit in 3 intra-group burst(s); control-population burst share is 6.1%
hypothesis_tests.verdict: SUPPORTED - 56% of the group vs 6.1% baseline

hypothesis_tests.hypothesis: registrar choice alone separates the corpus from unrelated themed domains
hypothesis_tests.test: registrar share of the corpus against the control population
hypothesis_tests.result: GoDaddy 31.8% vs 23.4% (lift 1.36); Squarespace (ex-Google Domains) 26.9% vs 4.4% (lift 6.09); Cloudflare 8.6% vs 3.9% (lift 2.2); Hostinger 6.9% vs 2.3% (lift 3.02); Wix 4.5% vs 0.2% (lift 25.37)
hypothesis_tests.verdict: PARTIAL - Squarespace (ex-Google Domains) is 6.09x over-represented, Hostinger is 3.02x over-represented, Wix is 25.37x over-represented; still a mass-market registrar shared with the controls, so vendor-level and not used for linking

soa_serial.caveat: SOA serial dates the last zone edit, not registration. It is a batch-detection signal only, never an age estimate.
